message: The default of the param 'phase' is not a constant expression: it reads `frame.time`, which changes at run time.
notes: a default may use only literals, constants, operators, conversions, constructors and const-eligible built-in functions
help: a default is fixed when the material is declared; give a value that changes to the instance instead, where an entity uses the material (`material: Name { param: bind(some_state) }`)
